sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 2595 of 2024

Petitioner :- Mohd. Vakeel And Others
Respondent :- Staet Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Civil Sectt. Lko And Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- D.P. Dutt Tiwari,Manish Kumar Mishra

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

The petitioners seek issuance of a writ in the nature of certiorari for quashing of the First Information Report dated 07.02.2024 bearing Case Crime No.0030 of 2024 under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Gomti Nagar Vistar District- Lucknow.
